title: PSSA: A non-transformer language model written from scratch in Rust
title_zh: PSSA: 一个从零开始用Rust编写的非变压器语言模型

paragraphs.en: PSSA: a non-transformer language model written from scratch in Rust. Recurrent state-space layer, episodic memory, self-modifying weights, CUDA training, and a full terminal dashboard.
paragraphs.zh: PSSA：一个用 Rust 从零编写的非 Transformer 语言模型。 循环状态空间层、情景记忆、自我修改权重、CUDA 训练，以及一个完整的终端仪表盘。

sents.en: PSSA: a non-transformer language model written from scratch in Rust.
sents.zh: PSSA：一个用 Rust 从零编写的非 Transformer 语言模型。

sents.en: Recurrent state-space layer, episodic memory, self-modifying weights, CUDA training, and a full terminal dashboard.
sents.zh: 循环状态空间层、情景记忆、自我修改权重、CUDA 训练，以及一个完整的终端仪表盘。

paragraphs.en: PSSA is a small language model that is not a transformer. It reads text one token at a time through a recurrent state-space layer, keeps a bank of episodic memories it can look things up in, and rewrites part of its own weights while it runs. It is written in Rust from scratch, with no PyTorch, no TensorFlow, and no ML framework of any kind underneath it.
paragraphs.zh: PSSA 是一个小型语言模型，但不是 Transformer 架构。 它通过一个循环状态空间层逐个词元地读取文本，保存一组可供查询的情节数据库，并在运行过程中重写自己的一部分权重。 它完全用 Rust 从零编写，底层没有任何 PyTorch、TensorFlow 或其他任何机器学习框架。

paragraphs.en: At matched parameters and on the same corpus, it learns faster than a transformer and generates text about twelve times quicker on the same CPU.
paragraphs.zh: 在参数量相同且语料库相同的情况下，智能体模型的学习速度比 transformer 更快，并且在同一 CPU 上生成文本的速度快约十二倍。

paragraphs.en: Not for speed points, and not because the language makes the architecture better. PSSA needed per-token weight updates, a memory bank written during the forward pass, and a scalar reference path that every batched kernel could be differentiated against. Expressing that inside an autograd framework meant fighting the framework at every step, so the linear algebra is written directly instead. That made the plastic parts straightforward and the gradients checkable against a reference to around 3e-8. The architecture is the claim here. The implementation language is a detail, and a Python port is welcome.
paragraphs.zh: 不是为了刷速度分数，也不是因为这门语言能让架构变得更好。 PSSA 需要逐 token 的权重更新、一个在前向传播过程中写入的记忆库，以及一条每个批量内核都可以对其求导的标量参考路径。 在自动微分框架内表达这些意味着每一步都在和框架对抗，因此线性代数部分是直接手写的。 这使得可塑部分变得简单直接，并且梯度可以对照参考实现校验到约 3e-8 的精度。 这里真正的核心主张是这个架构。 实现语言只是一个细节，欢迎用 Python 移植。

paragraphs.en: A transformer scores every pair of tokens in the context, so its cost per step grows with the square of the sequence length and the whole context is re-read at every step. PSSA carries one fixed-size state along the sequence in a single left-to-right pass, and looks things up in a memory bank instead of re-reading the context, so cost grows linearly with length.
paragraphs.zh: Transformer 会对上下文中每一对词元进行打分，因此其每步的开销随序列长度的平方增长，且每一步都要重新读取整个上下文。 PSSA 在一次从左到右的单遍处理中沿序列携带一个固定大小的状态，并通过查询记忆库而非重新读取上下文来获取信息，因此开销随长度线性增长。

paragraphs.en: PSSA training checks each target-token-weighted optimizer-group loss before Adam. It aborts without writing or replacing a checkpoint after three consecutive suspect groups: loss above 4 * ln(vocab) or above 8 * the healthy running loss (EWMA, alpha 1/8). The reference freezes during suspect streaks so a jump followed by a high plateau cannot hide itself. Isolated spikes recover. This is not a held-out validation monitor; a resumed run starts a fresh loss history.
paragraphs.zh: PSSA 训练会在 Adam 之前检查每个目标词元加权的优化器组损失。 在连续三个可疑组之后，它会中止且不写入或替换检查点：可疑指损失高于 4 * ln(vocab)，或高于健康运行损失的 8 倍（EWMA，alpha 为 1/8）。 参考模型在可疑连击期间保持冻结，因此先跳升后维持高位平台的损失无法自我掩盖。孤立的尖峰会自动恢复。 这不是一个留出验证监控器；恢复运行会开始一份全新的损失历史。

paragraphs.en: Full soft reads remain the default; the existing write/overwrite gate is unchanged. --memory N chooses fresh-run capacity. A resume still rejects a mismatched --memory ; use the explicit --grow-memory N instead (equal or larger only). Growth preserves occupied slots, confidence, timestamps, eviction order, parameters, Adam moments and recurrent state. The next checkpoint uses the existing format with larger arrays; no migration or new checkpoint version is involved.

paragraphs.en: pssa train corpus.txt --resume old.pssa --grow-memory 4096 -o grown.pssa --backend cpu pssa train corpus.txt --memory 1024 --memory-top-k 4 --backend cpu -o sparse.pssa pssa score heldout.txt --model sparse.pssa --memory-top-k 4 --memory-top-k K is an experimental exact nearest-slot read , not an ANN index: it still scans every occupied key, selects K by hyperbolic distance, renormalizes soft weights on those slots, and mixes only their values. Selection is piecewise constant in backward; gradients flow through selected weights. Training requires explicit --backend cpu ; GPU kernels are unchanged. K at least the occupied count takes the original full-read path. It may be slower, especially on small banks; do not assume a speed or accuracy improvement.
paragraphs.zh: pssa train corpus.txt --resume old.pssa --grow-memory 4096 -o grown.pssa --backend cpu pssa train corpus.txt --memory 1024 --memory-top-k 4 --backend cpu -o sparse.pssa pssa score heldout.txt --model sparse.pssa --memory-top-k 4 --memory-top-k K 是一种实验性的精确最近槽位读取，而非 ANN 索引：它仍会扫描每个已占用的键，按双曲距离选出 K 个槽位，在这些槽位上重新归一化软权重，并仅混合它们的值。 反向传播中选择是分段常数的；梯度仅流经被选中的权重。 训练需要显式指定 --backend cpu；GPU 内核保持不变。 当 K 不小于已占用数量时，走原来的完整读取路径。 它可能更慢，尤其是在小型存储库上；不要假设速度或精度会有提升。

paragraphs.en: pssa world-model pssa world-model --seed 73 --train-episodes 32 --heldout-episodes 12 --epochs 3 pssa world-model --help pssa world-model | pssa tui This bounded non-bio research mode trains a continuous PSSA recurrent backbone on a tiny fully observed box-pushing grid. A categorical posterior observes real frames; a learned prior predicts latents from history and actions. Training uses reconstruction, KL, reward and continuation objectives with straight-through categorical gradients. Imagination sees only the initial frame and subsequent actions. Learned recurrence is backpropagated across each episode, not frozen.
paragraphs.zh: pssa world-model pssa world-model --seed 73 --train-episodes 32 --heldout-episodes 12 --epochs 3 pssa world-model --help pssa world-model | pssa tui 这种受限的非生物研究模式在一个极小的完全可观测推箱子网格上训练连续的 PSSA 循环主干。 分类后验观测真实帧；学习到的先验根据历史和动作预测潜在变量。 训练使用重构、KL、奖励和延续目标，并采用直通式分类梯度。 想象过程只能看到初始帧和随后的动作。 学习到的循环在每个片段内进行反向传播，而不是被冻结。

paragraphs.en: The command compares against a plain autoregressive PSSA control using the same episodes, update count and recurrent widths. It reports before/after held-out next-frame NLL, open-loop NLL, field/exact accuracy, reward/continuation Brier, parameter counts and training time. NLL is nats per grid field, not text CE. Targets are scored before assimilation, held-out seeds are disjoint, and evaluation carries reset. This comparison is not parameter- or time-matched . The short three-seed example ( cargo run --profile fast --example boxes_world ) found lower next-frame NLL with the plain control in all three seeds; stochastic training was about 4.5× slower. Neither model solved the task at this budget.
paragraphs.zh: 该命令与使用相同回合数、更新次数和循环宽度的普通自回归 PSSA 对照进行对比。 它报告前后留出集下一帧 NLL、开环 NLL、字段/精确准确率、奖励/延续 Brier 分数、参数量以及训练时间。 NLL 是每个网格字段的自然单位，而非文本交叉熵。 目标在同化之前计分，留出种子互不重叠，评估过程中进行重置。 该比较在参数量或时间上并非匹配的。 简短的三种子示例（cargo run --profile fast --example boxes_world）中，普通对照在全部三个种子上均得到了更低的下一帧 NLL；随机训练慢了约 4.5 倍。 在该预算下，两个模型都没有解决该任务。

paragraphs.en: All settings are listed in --help : grid size, recurrent widths, categorical size, training/held-out episodes, episode/open-loop horizons, epochs, seed, learning rate, KL/auxiliary weights and gradient clipping. Individual ranges and a combined work cap reject oversized requests before allocation. Defaults finish quickly; quadratic episode backpropagation is a correctness reference, not a scalable training engine. No external corpus, GPU selection or checkpoint I/O is supported; train , score , checkpoint formats and GPU kernels are unchanged. The experiment makes no memory writes or adapter consolidation.

paragraphs.en: Every token goes through one PSSA layer: a selective state-space recurrence, a bounded read from an episodic memory bank in hyperbolic space, a learned gate that decides how much of that read reaches the residual stream, and a SiLU MLP. The defaults are d_m = 256 channels, d_s = 16 states per channel, and a rank-16 adapter.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 token 都会经过一个 PSSA 层：一个选择性状态空间递归、一次对双曲空间情景记忆库的有界读取、一个决定该读取有多少进入残差流的学习门控，以及一个 SiLU MLP。 默认设置为 d_m = 256 个通道、每通道 d_s = 16 个状态，以及一个秩为 16 的适配器。

sents.zh: 用 x 表示经过层归一化的词元嵌入。

sents.en: Three projections are read off the token itself, which is what makes the recurrence selective rather than fixed:
sents.zh: 三个投影直接从词元本身读取，这正是使循环具有选择性而非固定不变的原因：

paragraphs.en: delta = softplus(W_delta x) per-channel step size, delta in R^d_m B = W_B x input map, B in R^d_s C = W_C x output map, C in R^d_s The transition is diagonal, one rate per (channel, state) pair, kept negative by construction so the recurrence cannot blow up:
paragraphs.zh:
delta = softplus(W_delta x) 每通道步长，delta ∈ R^d_m
B = W_B x 输入映射，B ∈ R^d_s
C = W_C x 输出映射，C ∈ R^d_s

该转移是对角的，每个（通道，状态）对对应一个速率，且通过构造保持为负，因此递归不会发散：

paragraphs.en: A = -softplus(A_raw) A in R^(d_m x d_s) Discretizing that continuous system with step delta gives the per-token update. h carries across tokens and across chunk boundaries during training:
paragraphs.zh: A = -softplus(A_raw)，其中 A ∈ R^(d_m × d_s)。以步长 delta 对该连续系统进行离散化，即可得到逐 token 的更新。在训练过程中，h 会跨 token 以及跨块边界传递：

paragraphs.en: Abar_ij = exp(delta_i * A_ij) Bbar_ij = delta_i * B_j h_ij <- Abar_ij * h_ij + Bbar_ij * x_i y_i = sum_j C_j * h_ij A_raw is initialized so each channel's 16 rates sit on log-spaced timescales tau from 1.5 to 200 tokens, in the spirit of the HiPPO initialization. A single channel therefore starts out holding the last two tokens and the last two hundred at the same time, and training moves those horizons rather than discovering them from scratch.
paragraphs.zh: Abar_ij = exp(delta_i * A_ij)，Bbar_ij = delta_i * B_j，h_ij <- Abar_ij * h_ij + Bbar_ij * x_i，y_i = sum_j C_j * h_ij。A_raw 的初始化方式使每个通道的 16 个速率分布在从 1.5 到 200 个词元的对数间隔时间尺度 tau 上，这一做法秉承了 HiPPO 初始化的精神。 因此，单个通道一开始就同时保存着最近两个词元和最近两百个词元的信息，而训练过程是移动这些时间跨度，而不是从零开始发现它们。

paragraphs.en: This half of the layer is a selective diagonal SSM and claims no novelty; it is the same family as S4 and Mamba, written out scalar-first so the backward pass can be checked term by term.
paragraphs.zh: 该层的这一半是选择性对角 SSM，不声称有任何新颖性；它与 S4 和 Mamba 属于同一族，采用标量优先的方式写出，以便逐项检查反向传播过程。

paragraphs.en: The part that is specific to PSSA is what happens to y . A query is formed from both the current token and the current state, so retrieval is conditioned on where the recurrence has got to and not only on the token in hand:
paragraphs.zh: PSSA 特有的部分在于 y 所经历的处理过程。 查询由当前词元和当前状态共同构成，因此检索不仅取决于手头的词元，还取决于递归进行到了哪一步：

sents.en: The part that is specific to PSSA is what happens to y .
sents.zh: PSSA 特有的部分在于 y 所经历的处理过程。

sents.en: A query is formed from both the current token and the current state, so retrieval is conditioned on where the recurrence has got to and not only on the token in hand:

paragraphs.en: q = W_qx x + W_qh y qh = proj(q) diffeomorphic map into the Poincare ball, |qh| < 1 By default the read scans all occupied slots, weighted by a softmax over hyperbolic distance at temperature tau_mem . The opt-in CPU --memory-top-k K prototype instead normalizes over the K nearest slots after scanning all keys:
paragraphs.zh: q = W_qx x + W_qh y，qh = proj(q) 是到庞加莱球（Poincare ball）的微分同胚映射，满足 |qh| < 1。默认情况下，读取操作会扫描所有已占用的槽位，并以双曲距离上温度为 tau_mem 的 softmax 作为权重。 可选启用的 CPU --memory-top-k K 原型则是在扫描所有键之后，对 K 个最近的槽位进行归一化：

paragraphs.en: Hyperbolic distance grows toward the boundary of the ball, so slots holding general context and slots holding one specific episode stay separable without widening each key. Exact top-k reduces value mixing, not the linear key scan; it is not constant-cost retrieval as the occupied bank grows.
paragraphs.zh: 双曲距离向球的边界增长，因此持有一般上下文的槽位与持有某一具体情节的槽位无需加宽各自的键即可保持可分。 精确 top-k 减少的是值的混合，而非线性的键扫描；随着已占用库的增长，它并非常数成本的检索。

paragraphs.en: The read does not join the stream unconditionally. A learned per-channel gate decides how much of it lands, alongside a low-rank SiLU adapter that carries targeted updates:
paragraphs.zh: 该读取操作不会无条件地加入流中。 一个学习得到的逐通道门控决定其中多少内容被引入，同时配合一个携带针对性更新的低秩 SiLU 适配器：

sents.en: The read does not join the stream unconditionally.
sents.zh: 该读取操作不会无条件地加入流中。

sents.en: A learned per-channel gate decides how much of it lands, alongside a low-rank SiLU adapter that carries targeted updates:
sents.zh: 一个学习得到的逐通道门控决定其中多少内容被引入，同时配合一个携带针对性更新的低秩 SiLU 适配器：

paragraphs.en: g = sigmoid(W_gate x) z = s * y + g (elementwise) W_proj m + adapter(x) u = W_2 silu(W_1 z) z_out = z + u The write path Writes are the reason the architecture is called plastic. A slot is inserted when the incoming state is novel against what the bank already holds, each slot carries a refractory counter that rate-limits how often it can be overwritten, and fast plastic updates are folded back into the base transition matrix by a closed-form ridge regression rather than living in the external store forever:
paragraphs.zh: g = sigmoid(W_gate x)，z = s * y + g（逐元素相加），W_proj m + adapter(x)，u = W_2 silu(W_1 z)，z_out = z + u。写入路径正是这一架构被称为具有可塑性的原因。 当输入状态相对于记忆库中已有的内容是新颖时，就插入一个槽位；每个槽位带有一个不应期计数器，用于限制其被覆写的频率；快速的可塑性更新通过闭式岭回归折叠回基础转移矩阵，而不是永远留在外部存储中：

sents.en: g = sigmoid(W_gate x) z = s * y + g (elementwise) W_proj m + adapter(x) u = W_2 silu(W_1 z) z_out = z + u The write path Writes are the reason the architecture is called plastic.
sents.zh: g = sigmoid(W_gate x)，z = s * y + g（逐元素相加），W_proj m + adapter(x)，u = W_2 silu(W_1 z)，z_out = z + u。写入路径正是这一架构被称为具有可塑性的原因。

sents.en: A slot is inserted when the incoming state is novel against what the bank already holds, each slot carries a refractory counter that rate-limits how often it can be overwritten, and fast plastic updates are folded back into the base transition matrix by a closed-form ridge regression rather than living in the external store forever:
sents.zh: 当输入状态相对于记忆库中已有的内容是新颖时，就插入一个槽位；每个槽位带有一个不应期计数器，用于限制其被覆写的频率；快速的可塑性更新通过闭式岭回归折叠回基础转移矩阵，而不是永远留在外部存储中：

paragraphs.en: A_base <- A_base + (H^T H + lambda I)^-1 H^T dH The refractory counter is what keeps a stream of contradictory updates from erasing a slot that repeated evidence has already stabilized, and consolidation is what stops the bank from being the only place long-range structure is stored.
paragraphs.zh: A_base <- A_base + (H^T H + lambda I)^-1 H^T dH 不应期计数器的作用是防止一连串相互矛盾的更新抹去一个已被重复证据稳定的槽位，而巩固机制的作用是防止记忆库成为存储长程结构的唯一场所。

paragraphs.en: The recurrence is standard selective-SSM machinery. The claims are the hyperbolic bounded read conditioned on the recurrent state, the novelty and refractory rules on writes, and the ridge consolidation step from fast weights into the transition matrix. Everything is implemented against a scalar reference path that the batched and parallel implementations are differentiated against on every commit, currently agreeing to a maximum gradient error around 3e-8 ( cargo run --release --example twin_check ).
paragraphs.zh: 该递推是标准的选择性 SSM 机制。 其贡献点是基于循环状态的 双曲有界读取、写入的新颖性与不应期规则，以及从快权重到转移矩阵的岭回归巩固步骤。 所有实现均对照一个标量参考路径，批量化与并行化实现会在每次提交时与其进行差异化校验，目前最大梯度误差约为 3e-8（cargo run --release --example twin_check）。

paragraphs.en: Dreaming is an optional sleep phase between training updates. The model replays some stored memories, and it can also generate short rehearsal sequences, so useful patterns are revisited instead of being left behind by the newest batch. It is off by default and does not alter the normal training path when disabled.
paragraphs.zh: 做梦是训练更新之间的一个可选睡眠阶段。 模型会重放一些已存储的记忆，还能生成简短的预演回合，因此有用的模式会被重新回顾，而不是被最新的批次抛在后面。 该功能默认关闭，并且在禁用状态下不会改变正常的训练路径。

paragraphs.en: The whole result above was trained on a free hosted notebook with a single entry-level GPU, in 200,000-token links, because a session gets cut after a few hours. Every interesting question left, whether the gap holds at 10x or 100x these parameters, whether the memory bank matters at scale, how it does against a modern recurrent baseline, needs one thing: a GPU with real VRAM and allocations measured in days instead of hours. Anything meaningfully above the entry-level card this ran on changes what can be asked.

paragraphs.en: Direct runtime dependencies are ureq for dataset downloads and tokenizers for byte-level BPE. A GPU is optional. Built with --features cuda the dense matrix work dispatches through cuBLAS with a device-resident weight cache; a WebGPU adapter is used for the same stages when CUDA is unavailable, and software adapters are refused because they are slower than the CPU path. Everything falls back to the CPU implementation with no feature flags.
paragraphs.zh: 直接的运行时依赖是用于数据集下载的 ureq 和用于字节级 BPE 的 tokenizers。GPU 是可选的。 使用 --features cuda 构建时，稠密矩阵运算通过 cuBLAS 分发，并配有驻留设备的权重缓存；当 CUDA 不可用时，相同阶段会使用 WebGPU 适配器，而软件适配器会被拒绝，因为它们比 CPU 路径更慢。 在不启用任何特性开关的情况下，一切都会回退到 CPU 实现。

paragraphs.en: Both chains ran 64 links of 200,000 encoded tokens, each link resuming from the previous checkpoint, so the learning-rate schedule and optimizer state continue across the whole run instead of restarting per link.
paragraphs.zh: 两条链各运行了 64 段（links），每段包含 200,000 个编码后的 token，每一段都从上一个检查点恢复，因此学习率调度和优化器状态在整个运行过程中持续延续，而不是每段都重新开始。

paragraphs.en: Matching the optimizer schedule cuts one way and not the other: neither model received tuning the other did not, but a schedule that suits PSSA is not guaranteed to be the transformer's best, so part of the gap could be an undertrained baseline rather than the architecture. A per-model learning-rate sweep is running now, both models swept over the same grid on the same token budget, and the best-against-best numbers will be posted here when it finishes, whichever way they come out.
paragraphs.zh: 让优化器调度保持一致这种方式只对一方有利而对另一方不利：两个模型都没有接受对方所没有的调优，但适合 PSSA 的调度并不保证也是 transformer 的最优调度，因此差距的一部分可能来自训练不足的基线，而非架构本身。 针对每个模型的学习率扫描正在进行中，两个模型在相同的词元预算下按相同的网格进行扫描，扫描完成后将在此公布最优对最优的结果，无论结果如何。

paragraphs.en: The headline training rates come from different machines and say nothing on their own: PSSA trained on a Kaggle T4 at roughly 900 tokens/second, while the baseline is CPU-only because train-transformer has no GPU path, and held 212 tokens/second there. For a comparison that means something, both models were trained on the same CPU-only box, a 2-vCPU container with no GPU, over the same 199,059-token slice of the cleaned corpus with seed 42 and identical update counts. PSSA held 1,716 tokens/second against the baseline's 415, so 4.1x on matched hardware and matched work. An earlier measurement on Kaggle's CPU, before the scan parallelization, put the same pair at 375 against 212. The loss comparison above is unaffected either way, since it is matched on tokens and updates rather than on time.

paragraphs.en: Eval: automatically watches completed checkpoints, generating fixed greedy answers and teacher-forced reference-answer loss/perplexity in one separate, low-priority CPU process. It uses one thread, pauses between forwards, and has file/model/time limits (64 MiB checkpoint, 128 MiB model/tape allocation, 120 seconds); unsupported, oversized or invalid checkpoints are recorded as skipped, not training errors. The trainer never waits for evaluation. Results append to auto-eval.jsonl beside checkpoints, keyed by checkpoint identity and prompt-suite hash. The chart shows reference NLL over checkpoint numbers; answer panes compare adjacent checkpoints. Up/Down selects a checkpoint, PgUp/PgDn a prompt, a pauses/resumes, p edits the prompt JSON path (empty restores the built-in suite), and r reloads it. Copy assets/eval_prompts.json as a starting point; PSSA_EVAL_PROMPTS also supplies a startup path when no persisted path is set. Scores are tokenizer- specific, not a correctness grade or directly comparable across tokenizers. PSSA evaluation uses checkpoint memory, fresh carry, and runtime loops=1. The TUI must remain open to continue watching/evaluating. Memory: v switches the shared tab between the saved-checkpoint inspector ( r refreshes; PgUp/PgDn scroll) and live chat retrieval. While chat streams, the live view shows actual occupied-slot retrieval strengths from the latest PSSA token, ranked strength bars, and a bounded recent-token history. Query/input and predicted token are distinguished; stacked layers and the final loop pass are labelled. This is a read-only copy of existing inference state, not another retrieval or a synthetic animation. Transformer checkpoints report that they have no PSSA slots. No telemetry is saved to the checkpoint. Narrow terminals use compact/stacked layouts. Optional local speech capture (Linux/ALSA) is built with cargo build --release --features speech . Install an existing local whisper.cpp whisper-cli (or main ) and arecord , then set PSSA_WHISPER_BIN and PSSA_WHISPER_MODEL to the binary and ggml model paths. Without overrides the app searches PATH for whisper-cli / main and models/ggml-{base.en,base,tiny.en}.bin for a local model. /speech records ten seconds, transcribes locally, deletes temporary audio, and inserts text in the input box for review; it never auto-sends. Esc cancels the child process. Missing tools/model or a default build show enablement guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 评估：自动监视已完成的检查点，在一个独立的低优先级 CPU 进程中生成固定的贪心答案以及教师强制的参考答案损失/困惑度。 它只使用一个线程，在前向计算之间暂停，并设有文件/模型/时间限制（检查点 64 MiB，模型/纸带分配 128 MiB，120 秒）；不受支持、过大或无效的检查点会被记录为跳过，而不是训练错误。 训练器从不等待评估。 结果会追加到检查点旁边的 auto-eval.jsonl 中，以检查点标识和提示套件哈希为键。 图表显示各检查点编号上的参考 NLL；答案窗格对比相邻的检查点。 Up/Down 选择检查点，PgUp/PgDn 选择提示，a 暂停/恢复，p 编辑提示 JSON 路径（留空恢复内置套件），r 重新加载。 可复制 assets/eval_prompts.json 作为起点；在未设置持久化路径时，PSSA_EVAL_PROMPTS 也可在启动时提供路径。 分数依赖于具体的分词器，不是正确性评分，也不能在不同分词器之间直接比较。 PSSA 评估使用检查点记忆、全新的携带状态，以及运行时 loops=1。 终端界面必须保持打开才能继续监视/评估。 内存：v 在已保存检查点检查器（r 刷新；PgUp/PgDn 滚动）和实时聊天检索之间切换共享标签页。 聊天流式输出时，实时视图显示来自最新 PSSA 词元的实际占用槽位检索强度、按强度排序的条形图，以及有界的近期词元历史。 查询/输入与预测词元被区分开；堆叠的各层和最后一轮循环都会被标注。 这是对现有推理状态的只读副本，不是另一次检索，也不是合成的动画。 Transformer 检查点会报告自己没有 PSSA 槽位。 不会向检查点保存任何遥测数据。 窄终端使用紧凑/堆叠布局。 可选的本地语音采集（Linux/ALSA）通过 cargo build --release --features speech 构建。 安装现有的本地 whisper.cpp whisper-cli（或 main）和 arecord，然后将 PSSA_WHISPER_BIN 和 PSSA_WHISPER_MODEL 设置为二进制文件和 ggml 模型的路径。 未设置覆盖项时，应用会在 PATH 中搜索 whisper-cli / main，并在 models/ggml-{base.en,base,tiny.en}.bin 中寻找本地模型。/speech 录制十秒钟，本地转写，删除临时音频，并将文本插入输入框供审阅；它从不自动发送。 Esc 取消子进程。 缺少工具/模型或默认构建时会显示启用指引。

sents.en: It uses one thread, pauses between forwards, and has file/model/time limits (64 MiB checkpoint, 128 MiB model/tape allocation, 120 seconds); unsupported, oversized or invalid checkpoints are recorded as skipped, not training errors.
sents.zh: 它只使用一个线程，在前向计算之间暂停，并设有文件/模型/时间限制（检查点 64 MiB，模型/纸带分配 128 MiB，120 秒）；不受支持、过大或无效的检查点会被记录为跳过，而不是训练错误。

sents.en: The trainer never waits for evaluation.
sents.zh: 训练器从不等待评估。

sents.en: Results append to auto-eval.jsonl beside checkpoints, keyed by checkpoint identity and prompt-suite hash.
sents.zh: 结果会追加到检查点旁边的 auto-eval.jsonl 中，以检查点标识和提示套件哈希为键。

sents.en: The chart shows reference NLL over checkpoint numbers; answer panes compare adjacent checkpoints.
sents.zh: 图表显示各检查点编号上的参考 NLL；答案窗格对比相邻的检查点。

sents.en: Up/Down selects a checkpoint, PgUp/PgDn a prompt, a pauses/resumes, p edits the prompt JSON path (empty restores the built-in suite), and r reloads it.
sents.zh: Up/Down 选择检查点，PgUp/PgDn 选择提示，a 暂停/恢复，p 编辑提示 JSON 路径（留空恢复内置套件），r 重新加载。

sents.en: Copy assets/eval_prompts.json as a starting point; PSSA_EVAL_PROMPTS also supplies a startup path when no persisted path is set.
sents.zh: 可复制 assets/eval_prompts.json 作为起点；在未设置持久化路径时，PSSA_EVAL_PROMPTS 也可在启动时提供路径。

sents.en: Scores are tokenizer- specific, not a correctness grade or directly comparable across tokenizers.
sents.zh: 分数依赖于具体的分词器，不是正确性评分，也不能在不同分词器之间直接比较。

sents.en: PSSA evaluation uses checkpoint memory, fresh carry, and runtime loops=1.
sents.zh: PSSA 评估使用检查点记忆、全新的携带状态，以及运行时 loops=1。

sents.en: The TUI must remain open to continue watching/evaluating.
sents.zh: 终端界面必须保持打开才能继续监视/评估。

sents.en: Memory: v switches the shared tab between the saved-checkpoint inspector ( r refreshes; PgUp/PgDn scroll) and live chat retrieval.
sents.zh: 内存：v 在已保存检查点检查器（r 刷新；PgUp/PgDn 滚动）和实时聊天检索之间切换共享标签页。

sents.en: While chat streams, the live view shows actual occupied-slot retrieval strengths from the latest PSSA token, ranked strength bars, and a bounded recent-token history.
sents.zh: 聊天流式输出时，实时视图显示来自最新 PSSA 词元的实际占用槽位检索强度、按强度排序的条形图，以及有界的近期词元历史。

sents.en: Query/input and predicted token are distinguished; stacked layers and the final loop pass are labelled.
sents.zh: 查询/输入与预测词元被区分开；堆叠的各层和最后一轮循环都会被标注。

sents.en: This is a read-only copy of existing inference state, not another retrieval or a synthetic animation.
sents.zh: 这是对现有推理状态的只读副本，不是另一次检索，也不是合成的动画。

sents.en: Transformer checkpoints report that they have no PSSA slots.
sents.zh: Transformer 检查点会报告自己没有 PSSA 槽位。

sents.en: No telemetry is saved to the checkpoint.
sents.zh: 不会向检查点保存任何遥测数据。

sents.en: Narrow terminals use compact/stacked layouts.
sents.zh: 窄终端使用紧凑/堆叠布局。

sents.en: Optional local speech capture (Linux/ALSA) is built with cargo build --release --features speech .
sents.zh: 可选的本地语音采集（Linux/ALSA）通过 cargo build --release --features speech 构建。

sents.en: Install an existing local whisper.cpp whisper-cli (or main ) and arecord , then set PSSA_WHISPER_BIN and PSSA_WHISPER_MODEL to the binary and ggml model paths.
sents.zh: 安装现有的本地 whisper.cpp whisper-cli（或 main）和 arecord，然后将 PSSA_WHISPER_BIN 和 PSSA_WHISPER_MODEL 设置为二进制文件和 ggml 模型的路径。

sents.en: Without overrides the app searches PATH for whisper-cli / main and models/ggml-{base.en,base,tiny.en}.bin for a local model. /speech records ten seconds, transcribes locally, deletes temporary audio, and inserts text in the input box for review; it never auto-sends.
sents.zh: 未设置覆盖项时，应用会在 PATH 中搜索 whisper-cli / main，并在 models/ggml-{base.en,base,tiny.en}.bin 中寻找本地模型。/speech 录制十秒钟，本地转写，删除临时音频，并将文本插入输入框供审阅；它从不自动发送。

sents.en: Esc cancels the child process.
sents.zh: Esc 取消子进程。

sents.en: Missing tools/model or a default build show enablement guidance.
sents.zh: 缺少工具/模型或默认构建时会显示启用指引。

paragraphs.en: No models are downloaded and the default build has no audio dependencies .
paragraphs.zh: 不下载任何模型，且默认构建不包含音频依赖。

paragraphs.en: Positional arguments and long/short options can be mixed:
paragraphs.zh: 位置参数与长/短选项可以混合使用：

paragraphs.en: cargo run --release -- train data/downloaded.txt -e 2 -o data/experiment.pssa cargo run --release -- train --data data/downloaded.txt --epochs 2 --out data/experiment.pssa Chat commands Inside the REPL:
paragraphs.zh: cargo run --release -- train data/downloaded.txt -e 2 -o data/experiment.pssa cargo run --release -- train --data data/downloaded.txt --epochs 2 --out data/experiment.pssa 聊天命令 在 REPL 中：

paragraphs.en: --skip-tokens , --max-tokens and --resume together let a long corpus be trained as a chain of short runs, so a single run never has to survive a session limit. If a window crosses EOF, selection wraps to the beginning of the corpus. Each link trains its own window and hands its optimizer state to the next:
paragraphs.zh: --skip-tokens、--max-tokens 与 --resume 三者配合，可将长语料库作为一串短程训练来运行，因此单次运行无需承受会话时限的约束。 如果窗口跨越 EOF，选取会回绕到语料库的开头。 每一环训练自己的窗口，并把优化器状态交给下一环：

sents.en: --skip-tokens , --max-tokens and --resume together let a long corpus be trained as a chain of short runs, so a single run never has to survive a session limit.
sents.zh: --skip-tokens、--max-tokens 与 --resume 三者配合，可将长语料库作为一串短程训练来运行，因此单次运行无需承受会话时限的约束。

sents.en: If a window crosses EOF, selection wraps to the beginning of the corpus.
sents.zh: 如果窗口跨越 EOF，选取会回绕到语料库的开头。

sents.en: Each link trains its own window and hands its optimizer state to the next:
sents.zh: 每一环训练自己的窗口，并把优化器状态交给下一环：

paragraphs.en: cargo run --release -- train data/downloaded.txt -e 1 \ --skip-tokens 0 --max-tokens 200000 -o chain/ck01.pssa cargo run --release -- train data/downloaded.txt -e 1 \ --skip-tokens 200000 --max-tokens 200000 --resume chain/ck01.pssa -o chain/ck02.pssa For opt-in divergence containment, add e.g. --grad-clip 1.0 --memory-value-cap 512 . Clipping runs after gradient accumulation, immediately before Adam on CPU and GPU; progress reports the pre-clip grad_norm . A non-finite norm clears gradients and skips the update without advancing Adam moments, step count, or the LR schedule; the data group is not retried. Warnings and skipped_updates count these skips, and the 21st consecutive skip aborts without saving. The memory cap rescales vectors (not individual coordinates); key norms and other bank metadata are unchanged. Both flags default off, preserve the checkpoint format, and are runtime-only: repeat them on every resumed link . The example cap is a policy choice, not a guarantee of stability or a universal model-scale setting.
paragraphs.zh: cargo run --release -- train data/downloaded.txt -e 1 \ --skip-tokens 0 --max-tokens 200000 -o chain/ck01.pssa cargo run --release -- train data/downloaded.txt -e 1 \ --skip-tokens 200000 --max-tokens 200000 --resume chain/ck01.pssa -o chain/ck02.pssa 如需可选的分歧控制，可加上例如 --grad-clip 1.0 --memory-value-cap 512 。 梯度裁剪在梯度累加之后进行，紧接在 CPU 和 GPU 上的 Adam 之前；进度报告显示的是裁剪前的 grad_norm 。 非有限范数会清除梯度并跳过本次更新，不推进 Adam 动量、步数或学习率调度；该数据组不会被重试。 警告和 skipped_updates 会统计这些跳过，连续第 21 次跳过会中止且不保存。 内存上限对向量整体（而非单个坐标）进行缩放；键范数和其它库元数据保持不变。 这两个标志默认关闭，保持检查点格式不变，且仅在运行时生效：在每条恢复链接上都需要重复指定它们。 示例中的上限是一种策略选择，并不保证稳定性，也不是适用于所有模型规模的通用设置。

sents.en: cargo run --release -- train data/downloaded.txt -e 1 \ --skip-tokens 0 --max-tokens 200000 -o chain/ck01.pssa cargo run --release -- train data/downloaded.txt -e 1 \ --skip-tokens 200000 --max-tokens 200000 --resume chain/ck01.pssa -o chain/ck02.pssa For opt-in divergence containment, add e.g. --grad-clip 1.0 --memory-value-cap 512 .
sents.zh: cargo run --release -- train data/downloaded.txt -e 1 \ --skip-tokens 0 --max-tokens 200000 -o chain/ck01.pssa cargo run --release -- train data/downloaded.txt -e 1 \ --skip-tokens 200000 --max-tokens 200000 --resume chain/ck01.pssa -o chain/ck02.pssa 如需可选的分歧控制，可加上例如 --grad-clip 1.0 --memory-value-cap 512 。

sents.en: Clipping runs after gradient accumulation, immediately before Adam on CPU and GPU; progress reports the pre-clip grad_norm .
sents.zh: 梯度裁剪在梯度累加之后进行，紧接在 CPU 和 GPU 上的 Adam 之前；进度报告显示的是裁剪前的 grad_norm 。

sents.en: A non-finite norm clears gradients and skips the update without advancing Adam moments, step count, or the LR schedule; the data group is not retried.
sents.zh: 非有限范数会清除梯度并跳过本次更新，不推进 Adam 动量、步数或学习率调度；该数据组不会被重试。

sents.en: Warnings and skipped_updates count these skips, and the 21st consecutive skip aborts without saving.
sents.zh: 警告和 skipped_updates 会统计这些跳过，连续第 21 次跳过会中止且不保存。

sents.en: The memory cap rescales vectors (not individual coordinates); key norms and other bank metadata are unchanged.
sents.zh: 内存上限对向量整体（而非单个坐标）进行缩放；键范数和其它库元数据保持不变。

sents.en: Both flags default off, preserve the checkpoint format, and are runtime-only: repeat them on every resumed link .
sents.zh: 这两个标志默认关闭，保持检查点格式不变，且仅在运行时生效：在每条恢复链接上都需要重复指定它们。

sents.en: The example cap is a policy choice, not a guarantee of stability or a universal model-scale setting.
sents.zh: 示例中的上限是一种策略选择，并不保证稳定性，也不是适用于所有模型规模的通用设置。

paragraphs.en: kaggle/kaggle_continue.sh drives this pattern end to end: it sets a window size and a link count, walks the corpus offset by offset, and resumes each link from the previous checkpoint. status then reports every checkpoint in the chain with its shape and optimizer step count.
paragraphs.zh: kaggle/kaggle_continue.sh 端到端地驱动这一模式：它设置窗口大小和链接数，逐个偏移量遍历语料库，并从上一个检查点恢复每个链接。status 随后报告链中每个检查点的形状和优化器步数。

paragraphs.en: DatasetManager accepts one or more comma-separated sources:
paragraphs.zh: DatasetManager 接受一个或多个以逗号分隔的数据源：

paragraphs.en: cargo run --release -- train science # built-in reference corpus cargo run --release -- train data/downloaded.txt # local text file cargo run --release -- train data/ # every readable file in a directory cargo run --release -- train https://example.org/corpus.txt cargo run --release -- train hf:owner/dataset # Hugging Face repository cargo run --release -- train science,data/downloaded.txt # multiple sources Local files and directories are read directly; HTTP(S) URLs and explicit hf:owner/dataset sources are downloaded. Structured responses are reduced using common fields such as text , content , article , story , instruction , output , sentence , and summary ; structured responses without a supported text field are rejected.
paragraphs.zh: cargo run --release -- train science # 内置参考语料库 cargo run --release -- train data/downloaded.txt # 本地文本文件 cargo run --release -- train data/ # 目录下所有可读文件 cargo run --release -- train https://example.org/corpus.txt cargo run --release -- train hf:owner/dataset # Hugging Face 仓库 cargo run --release -- train science,data/downloaded.txt # 多个来源 本地文件和目录会直接读取；HTTP(S) URL 以及显式的 hf:owner/dataset 来源则会被下载。 结构化响应会使用诸如 text、content、article、story、instruction、output、sentence 和 summary 等常见字段进行精简；不含受支持文本字段的结构化响应将被拒绝。

sents.en: cargo run --release -- train science # built-in reference corpus cargo run --release -- train data/downloaded.txt # local text file cargo run --release -- train data/ # every readable file in a directory cargo run --release -- train https://example.org/corpus.txt cargo run --release -- train hf:owner/dataset # Hugging Face repository cargo run --release -- train science,data/downloaded.txt # multiple sources Local files and directories are read directly; HTTP(S) URLs and explicit hf:owner/dataset sources are downloaded.
sents.zh: cargo run --release -- train science # 内置参考语料库 cargo run --release -- train data/downloaded.txt # 本地文本文件 cargo run --release -- train data/ # 目录下所有可读文件 cargo run --release -- train https://example.org/corpus.txt cargo run --release -- train hf:owner/dataset # Hugging Face 仓库 cargo run --release -- train science,data/downloaded.txt # 多个来源 本地文件和目录会直接读取；HTTP(S) URL 以及显式的 hf:owner/dataset 来源则会被下载。

sents.en: Structured responses are reduced using common fields such as text , content , article , story , instruction , output , sentence , and summary ; structured responses without a supported text field are rejected.
sents.zh: 结构化响应会使用诸如 text、content、article、story、instruction、output、sentence 和 summary 等常见字段进行精简；不含受支持文本字段的结构化响应将被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: Byte-level BPE keeps exact UTF-8 case, whitespace, punctuation, and line endings, and has a complete 256-byte fallback alphabet, so valid UTF-8 never collapses to <unk> . The previous lowercase word splitter, including its 10,000-word cap and <unk> behavior, is available only with --tokenizer word .
paragraphs.zh: 字节级 BPE 能精确保留 UTF-8 的大小写、空白、标点和换行符，并拥有完整的 256 字节回退字母表，因此有效的 UTF-8 永远不会折叠为 <unk> 。 先前的小写词级分词器，包括其 10,000 词的上限和 <unk> 行为，仅在使用 --tokenizer word 时可用。

paragraphs.en: Download a Hugging Face dataset into a local text file:
paragraphs.zh: 将 Hugging Face 数据集下载到本地文本文件中：

paragraphs.en: cargo run --release -- download wikimedia/wikipedia --out data/downloaded.txt Hugging Face training and live feed pssa train --hf-dataset Salesforce/wikitext \ --hf-config wikitext-103-v1 --hf-split train --hf-field text \ --max-tokens 200000 -e 1 --no-tui | pssa tui Use Tab to open feed : it shows the dataset, completed selected-window rows, trained tokens, and a short decoded preview sliding into a token-ID shredder. The displayed IDs are actual input tokens from the latest reported training chunk; with batching, the preview is the last lane in that update. Row counts include repeated epochs/windows, and the selected row number is after skip/cap selection, not a global Hugging Face row ID. Older logs and local training still work without sample metadata. The animation is cosmetic and runs only in the log reader.

paragraphs.en: HF downloads use the datasets-server rows API, streaming pages to an atomic disk cache before the existing in-memory tokenizer/trainer reads the corpus. This is not online/infinite-dataset training: --max-tokens caps training, not the download. Set PSSA_HF_CACHE to a writable cache directory (for example /kaggle/working/pssa-hf-cache on Kaggle, with Internet enabled); otherwise the cache lives under $XDG_CACHE_HOME/pssa/huggingface or ~/.cache/pssa/huggingface . Cached data can be reused offline; delete its cache file to refresh it. Choose a configuration explicitly when discovery reports multiple choices.
paragraphs.zh: HF 下载使用 datasets-server 的 rows API，将数据分页流式写入原子磁盘缓存，之后现有的内存中 tokenizer/trainer 再读取语料。 这不是在线/无限数据集训练：--max-tokens 限制的是训练，而不是下载。 将 PSSA_HF_CACHE 设置为一个可写的缓存目录（例如在 Kaggle 上开启 Internet 后设为 /kaggle/working/pssa-hf-cache）；否则缓存将位于 $XDG_CACHE_HOME/pssa/huggingface 或 ~/.cache/pssa/huggingface 下。 缓存的数据可离线复用；删除其缓存文件即可刷新。 当发现步骤报告多个可选项时，请显式选择一个配置。

paragraphs.en: Renamed environment variables still accept their legacy OXIDE_* fallback when the corresponding PSSA_* variable is unset (including OXIDE_PSSA_HF_CACHE for PSSA_HF_CACHE ). A set PSSA_* value always takes precedence, even if empty.

paragraphs.en: For private/gated datasets, open HF login with Tab in pssa tui . Enter a read token (masked) and press Enter : the app verifies the account with HF's whoami-v2 API and atomically saves ~/.cache/huggingface/token with mode 0600 . Existing HF_TOKEN credentials take precedence over that file on startup; plain CLI downloads use the same credentials as a Bearer header. No token is shown in logs or errors. Esc clears entry; Ctrl+L logs out and removes the saved file. Explicit login/logout also applies to subsequently wizard-launched trainers, without passing tokens in command arguments. Already-running trainers keep their credentials. Also unset HF_TOKEN in your parent shell to sign out future independently launched CLI runs. Login does not grant gated access: request/accept access on the dataset's Hugging Face page and wait for approval. Logout does not remove already downloaded dataset caches.
paragraphs.zh: 对于私有/受限数据集，可在 pssa tui 中用 Tab 键打开 Hugging Face 登录。 输入只读令牌（以掩码显示）并按回车键：应用会通过 HF 的 whoami-v2 API 验证账户，并以 0600 权限原子性地保存 ~/.cache/huggingface/token 文件。 启动时已有的 HF_TOKEN 凭据优先于该文件；普通 CLI 下载使用相同凭据作为 Bearer 请求头。 令牌不会出现在日志或错误信息中。 Esc 键清空输入；Ctrl+L 登出并删除已保存的文件。 显式登录/登出同样适用于随后由向导启动的训练器，无需在命令参数中传递令牌。 已在运行的训练器保留其原有凭据。 若要让未来独立启动的 CLI 运行也登出，请在你的父 shell 中同时取消设置 HF_TOKEN。 登录并不会授予受限数据集的访问权限：请在该数据集的 Hugging Face 页面上申请并接受访问，等待审批通过。 登出不会删除已下载的数据集缓存。

paragraphs.en: HF runs add percent-encoded feed_* fields to the existing throttled progress lines (at most every five seconds when piped, plus first/final updates). These include a short sample of dataset content; treat saved logs accordingly. Local runs do not add these fields. Do not combine --hf-dataset with a positional source or --data .

paragraphs.en: Clean extracted wikitext-103-raw text before a fresh training run :
paragraphs.zh: 在一次全新的训练运行之前，从 wikitext-103-raw 中提取的干净文本：

paragraphs.en: ./target/release/pssa clean-wikitext wiki.train.raw --out data/wikitext-clean.txt ./target/release/pssa train data/wikitext-clean.txt -o data/model.pssa # Also available: pssa help clean-wikitext The same command can be used in Kaggle after extracting text from Parquet; it accepts a local UTF-8 text file, not Parquet itself. -o and --out are aliases. The output path is required and must not already exist (including the input path or a link to it). This protects the original corpus; choose a new output name for another run. Read, UTF-8, and write failures exit nonzero through the normal CLI error path, with partial output removed when possible.
paragraphs.zh: ./target/release/pssa clean-wikitext wiki.train.raw --out data/wikitext-clean.txt ./target/release/pssa train data/wikitext-clean.txt -o data/model.pssa # 另外可用：pssa help clean-wikitext 从 Parquet 提取文本后，同样的命令也可以在 Kaggle 上使用；它接受的是本地 UTF-8 文本文件，而不是 Parquet 本身。-o 和 --out 是别名。 输出路径是必需的，并且必须尚不存在（包括输入路径或指向它的链接）。 这可以保护原始语料库；再次运行时请选择一个新的输出名称。 读取、UTF-8 和写入失败会通过正常的 CLI 错误路径以非零值退出，并在可能的情况下删除部分输出。

sents.zh: 读取、UTF-8 和写入失败会通过正常的 CLI 错误路径以非零值退出，并在可能的情况下删除部分输出。

paragraphs.en: pssa::dataset::clean_wikitext(reader, writer) is the reusable library API ( BufRead / Write , returning std::io::Result<()> ). The CLI uses buffered file I/O, and the cleaner retains only its input/output line buffers: memory is proportional to the longest line, not the corpus size. Library callers using a buffered writer must flush it themselves; the CLI explicitly checks the flush. No new dependencies are required.
paragraphs.zh: pssa::dataset::clean_wikitext(reader, writer) 是可复用的库 API（BufRead / Write，返回 std::io::Result<()>）。 该命令行界面（CLI）使用带缓冲的文件输入/输出，清洗器仅保留其输入/输出行缓冲区：内存占用与最长行成正比，而与语料库大小无关。 使用带缓冲写入器的库调用方必须自行执行刷新（flush）；CLI 则显式检查该刷新操作。 无需引入新的依赖。

paragraphs.en: Cleaning is opt-in: existing loaders, tokenizers, training commands, and kaggle/kaggle_continue.sh are unchanged. Do not switch an in-flight resume chain to a cleaned corpus : cleaning changes token IDs/counts and the meaning of --skip-tokens offsets. Prepare and consistently reuse one cleaned corpus for a new chain instead.
paragraphs.zh: 清洗是可选项：现有的加载器、分词器、训练命令以及 kaggle/kaggle_continue.sh 均保持不变。 不要将正在进行中的续训链切换到清洗后的语料库：清洗会改变 token ID/数量以及 --skip-tokens 偏移量的含义。 相反，应准备一个清洗后的语料库并始终如一地将其用于新的续训链。

paragraphs.en: Defaults are latent 256, recurrent state 16, memory-key 32, memory capacity 512, chunk length 64, learning rate 1e-3, 8 chunks per update, and seed 42. The resulting binary holds weights, configuration, memory, adapters, and optimizer state. It is not an interchange format for other ML frameworks and should be loaded through PSSALayer::import_from_pssa_bytes .
paragraphs.zh: 默认值为潜在维度 256、循环状态 16、记忆键 32、记忆容量 512、块长度 64、学习率 1e-3、每次更新 8 个块，随机种子 42。 生成的一体化二进制文件包含权重、配置、记忆、适配器以及优化器状态。 它不是面向其他机器学习框架的交换格式，应通过 PSSALayer::import_from_pssa_bytes 进行加载。

paragraphs.en: New saves use V7 : the full V6 training/resume payload plus a bounded, length-prefixed standard tokenizer JSON. A V7 BPE checkpoint is self-contained and restores its exact ordered vocabulary without access to the training or evaluation corpus. generate and chat reject --data for V7 BPE because retraining a tokenizer on external data would not validate provenance. V7 word checkpoints and V6 checkpoints retain the legacy optional --data exact-vocabulary comparison. Checked V5 artifacts remain inference-only and require --data because they never contained tokenizer provenance.
paragraphs.zh: 新保存的存档使用 V7：即完整的 V6 训练/恢复载荷，外加一个有界、带长度前缀的标准分词器 JSON。 V7 BPE 检查点是自包含的，无需访问训练或评估语料库即可恢复其确切的有序词表。对于 V7 BPE，generate 和 chat 会拒绝 --data 参数，因为在外部数据上重新训练分词器无法验证来源。 V7 词级检查点和 V6 检查点保留传统的可选 --data 精确词表比较。 已检查的 V5 工件仍然仅用于推理，并需要 --data 参数，因为它们从未包含分词器来源信息。

paragraphs.en: Generation is autoregressive and uses temperature 0.70, a top-24 candidate limit followed by top-p 0.85 filtering, a 1.25 repetition penalty over a recent 64-token window, immediate self-transition suppression, <unk> suppression, and a default cap of 64 new tokens, ending early after two generated periods.
paragraphs.zh: 生成采用自回归方式，使用温度 0.70、前 24 个候选限制后接 top-p 0.85 过滤、在最近 64 个 token 窗口上施加 1.25 的重复惩罚、立即的自转移抑制、<unk> 抑制，以及默认 64 个新 token 的上限，并在生成两个句号后提前结束。

paragraphs.en: V7 BPE inference restores the exact embedded tokenizer and never rebuilds it from a selected dataset. Evaluation supplies its data only as held-out text to the restored tokenizer.
paragraphs.zh: V7 BPE 推理会恢复嵌入的确切分词器，而绝不会根据所选数据集重建它。 评估仅以留出文本的形式向恢复的分词器提供其数据。

paragraphs.en: cargo run --release -- benchmark The suite exercises synthetic streams for contradictory facts, MQAR-style distractors, burst repetition, model serialization, and short generation prompts. It prints milestone results, is not wired into Cargo's test harness, and is not a quality evaluation on general language tasks.
paragraphs.zh: cargo run --release -- benchmark 该测试套件通过合成数据流来测试矛盾事实、MQAR 风格的干扰项、突发重复、模型序列化以及短生成提示。 它会打印阶段性结果，未接入 Cargo 的测试框架，也不是针对通用语言任务的质量评估。

paragraphs.zh: 对于重复的本地编辑，请使用优化后的增量快速配置（incremental fast profile）：

paragraphs.en: cargo check --profile fast --tests cargo build --profile fast cargo test --profile fast cargo run --profile fast -- help # Optional NVIDIA CUDA backend: cargo build --profile fast --features cuda This profile enables incremental compilation, disables LTO, and uses 16 codegen units while retaining optimization level 3. Its binaries and compiler cache live under target/fast/ . The first build populates the cache; subsequent edits can reuse it. Debug builds ( cargo build ) already enable incremental compilation. Keep using the normal release profile for reproducible performance measurements.
paragraphs.zh: cargo check --profile fast --tests cargo build --profile fast cargo test --profile fast cargo run --profile fast -- help # 可选的 NVIDIA CUDA 后端：cargo build --profile fast --features cuda 该配置启用了增量编译，禁用了 LTO，并在保留优化级别 3 的同时使用 16 个代码生成单元。 其二进制文件和编译器缓存位于 target/fast/ 目录下。 首次构建会生成缓存；后续编辑可以复用它。 调试构建（cargo build）本身已启用增量编译。 进行可复现的性能测量时，请继续使用常规的 release 配置。

paragraphs.en: cargo fmt --all -- --check cargo clippy --release --all-targets cargo test --release Integration tests live in tests/ : allocations.rs , bpe_repair.rs , checkpoint_repair.rs , core_repair.rs , linalg.rs , and runtime_repair.rs , with shared artifacts under tests/fixtures/ . They cover tokenizer round trips, checkpoint import/export across versions, linear-algebra kernels, allocation behavior, and CLI runtime output. Clippy is clean of errors; a number of style warnings in the numeric kernels are left in place deliberately, since rewriting indexed loops there would churn code the gradient tests pin down.
paragraphs.zh: cargo fmt --all -- --check cargo clippy --release --all-targets cargo test --release 集成测试位于 tests/ 目录下：allocations.rs、bpe_repair.rs、checkpoint_repair.rs、core_repair.rs、linalg.rs 和 runtime_repair.rs，共享的测试工件存放在 tests/fixtures/ 目录下。 它们涵盖分词器的往返转换、跨版本的检查点导入/导出、线性代数内核、内存分配行为，以及 CLI 运行时输出。 Clippy 没有错误；数值内核中存在的一些风格警告是刻意保留的，因为重写其中的索引循环会大幅改动梯度测试所固定的代码。

sents.zh: 它们涵盖分词器的往返转换、跨版本的检查点导入/导出、线性代数内核、内存分配行为，以及 CLI 运行时输出。

sents.en: Clippy is clean of errors; a number of style warnings in the numeric kernels are left in place deliberately, since rewriting indexed loops there would churn code the gradient tests pin down.
sents.zh: Clippy 没有错误；数值内核中存在的一些风格警告是刻意保留的，因为重写其中的索引循环会大幅改动梯度测试所固定的代码。
